user.title: Visit Heatmap
user.description: Records visit points from every GPS device_tracker entity and exposes them to the Visit Heatmap card. No configuration needed.

abort.already_configured: Visit Heatmap is already configured. Add a Visit Heatmap card to a dashboard to use it.

init.title: Visit Heatmap options
init.description: Tune how fixes are classified and stored.

data.dedupe_radius: Dedupe radius (m): a new fix this close to a past visit refreshes it instead of adding a duplicate
data.move_speed_threshold: Moving speed threshold (m/s): fixes above this speed are treated as travel
data.retention_days: Retention (days): how long visits are kept, regardless of a card's horizon
data.backfill_days: Backfill (days): recorder history imported on first install
